en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al Barqy, from Ali Bin Hassan and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara Bin Ayn, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Everyone who exceeds the Sunnah should be returned back to the Sunnah’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Barqi from Ali ibn Hassa’n and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Salama ibn al-Khattab from Ali ibn Hassa’n from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurara ibn A‘yan from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following. “
Whoever may transgress against the Sunnah, noble traditions of the holy Prophet (s.a.), he must return to the Sunnah.”
